name: Unilumin Group Co., Ltd
summary: Unilumin Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of LED display and lighting products in China and internationally. It offers professional, commercial, outdoor, rental, creative, and UTV LED products; and professional and commercial display, smart conference, sports venues and events, rental and staging, media architecture, and functional lighting solutions. The company also provides maintenance services, troubleshooting, spare parts, precision maintenance, preventive check, installation, training program, and upgrade. It exports its products.
